title: AI-SDLC CapabilitiesConfig
description: Per-repository declaration of the optional capabilities that are expected to be live. A required capability that is degraded or never observed makes the doctor capability-liveness check fail and files a Decision; nothing is ever blocked. Lives at .ai-sdlc/capabilities.yaml and is read from the trusted base branch only. The default is an empty list.

required.description: Capability ids this repository expects to be live, for example dor.stage-b.
